findings.title: Error message uses raw input instead of cleaned value
findings.body: The error message on line 8 uses the original `raw` input in the message, which may contain leading/trailing whitespace or inconsistent casing. Use the cleaned value (`cleaned`) in the error message to match the actual validation performed.

summary.problem: The new validation raises an error with the unprocessed input, which may mislead users about the actual invalid value.
summary.done_well: The function now validates the presence of '@' and raises a clear error for non-email inputs.
